claim_policy.documented_current_narrative: A dated 2023-2026 source documents circulation or active monitoring of this narrative family. This does not estimate population prevalence.
claim_policy.current_risk_analogue: Current sources document the underlying risk or closely related narrative, but the exact benchmark formulation is selected primarily for construct coverage.
claim_policy.cross_domain_composite: The item composes separately documented current narratives to test totalizing reasoning; it is not presented as one naturally occurring verbatim theory.
